citations.claim: Microsoft reported Q1 FY2025 M365 consumer products and cloud services revenue growth of 5%, or 6% in constant currency.
citations.source_text: M365 consumer products and cloud services revenue increased 5% and 6% in constant currency.

citations.claim: Microsoft reported LinkedIn revenue growth of 10%, or 9% in constant currency, slightly ahead of expectations, with growth across its business lines.
citations.source_text: Linked in revenue increased 10% and 9% in constant currency, slightly ahead of expectations, with growth across all lines of business.

citations.claim: Microsoft reported free cash flow of $19.3 billion, down 7% year over year, reflecting higher capital expenditures for cloud and AI offerings.
citations.source_text: Free cash flow was 19.3 billion dollars down 7% year over year reflecting higher capital expenditures to support our cloud and AI offerings.

citations.claim: Microsoft reported enterprise and partner services revenue down 1%, or relatively unchanged in constant currency.
citations.source_text: Enterprise and partner services revenue decreased 1% and was relatively unchanged in constant currency.

citations.claim: Microsoft reported Microsoft Cloud gross margin of 71%, lower year over year.
citations.source_text: Microsoft cloud gross margin percentage decreased 2.0 over year to 71%.
